///THIS REPORT WAS RECEIVED VIA THE WEB REPORTING TOOL.///ON 09/15/13 AT 1925 HOURS, TERMINAL TRAINMASTER, REPORTED A SUSPECT ODOR NEAR A BLOCK OF 16 CARS THAT REPORTEDLY CONTAINED A HIGHLY FLAMMABLE COMMODITY (POSSIBLY BUTANE), BUT HAD BEEN UNABLE TO LOCATE A LEAK OR SPILL AT MP ANB 865.00 ON AN UNKNOWN SUBDIVISION. THIS WAS LOCATED ACROSS FROM THE HUMP TOWER ON DEPARTURE TRACK B9 IN THE TILFORD YARD, 1942 MARIETTA BOULEVARD, IN ATLANTA, GEORGIA. CRISIS COMMUNICATIONS MANAGER, WAS NOTIFIED. UPDATE: AT 2159 HOURS, CRISIS COMMUNICATIONS MANAGER, ADVISED THE DOME ON ONE OF THE CARS IS FROSTED OVER SO THERE IS A PRODUCT RELEASE BUT THERE IS NO PRODUCT ON THE GROUND. ATLANTA POLICE WERE NOTIFIED. UPDATE: AT 2227 HOURS, CRISIS COMMUNICATIONS MANAGER, ADVISED THE CAR NUMBER IS SHPX 221121. HULLS, ENVIRONMENTAL SERVICES, ARE ON SCENE.

WHILE WALKING ALONG THE MISSISSIPPI RIVER’S BANK ON NOVEMBER 19, 2010 (ALONG THE REVETMENT), SMALL SHEEN CIRCLES WERE OBSERVED ON THE WATER. UPON INSPECTION, IT WAS DETERMINED THE SOURCE MAY BE AN INTERMITTENT SEEP OF LIGHT NON AQUEOUS PHASE LIQUID (LNAPL) GLOBULES RESULTING FROM HISTORIC OPERATIONS AT THE FACILITY. THE SHEEN DISSIPATED QUICKLY AFTER FIRST APPEARING ON THE WATER. A SIMILAR INCIDENT OCCURRED ON NOVEMBER 10, 2010, AND WAS REPORTED TO THE NRC UNDER INCIDENT REPORT # 959615 AND LDEQ SPOC SYSTEM INCIDENT REPORT # GT01 8451. THIS AREA IS CURRENTLY BEING INVESTIGATED UNDER THE DIRECTION OF THE LDEQ (AI NO. 1708).

properties.summary: Incident Type: FIXED - NRC Report ID: 1011621 - Medium Affected: WATER - Suspected Responsible Party: QG, LLC
properties.content:
Report Details
NRC Report ID: 1011621
Incident Time: 2012-05-14 11:30:00
Nearest City: Dickson, TN
Location: PLATING OPERATIONS ARE LOCATED IN THE MIDDLE OF THE FACILITY. 1665 OLD COLUMBIA HIGHWAY
Incident Type: FIXED
Material: HEXAVALENT CHROME
Medium Affected: WATER
Suspected Responsible Party: QG, LLC
SkyTruth Analysis
Lat/Long: 36.075035, -87.385686 (Approximated from ZIP)
Report Description
FACILITY PERSONNEL DISCOVERED A BREACH IN A TRENCH LINE AND ASSOCIATED SUMP THAT IS UTILIZED TO CONVEY RINSE WATER FROM COPPER PLATING TANKS. THE RINSE WATER CONTAINS MISCELLANEOUS SOLVENT AND COPPER SULFATE. IN ADDITION, THE ASSOCIATED SUMP ALSO COLLECTS RINSE WATER FROM CHROME SCRUBBER EQUIPMENT. THIS RINSE WATER MAY CONTAIN TRACE AMOUNTS OF HEXAVALENT CHROME. THE RINSE WATERS ARE TRANSFERRED FROM THE ASSOCIATED SUMP TO AN ONSITE WATER PRETREATMENT SYSTEM BEFORE FINAL DISCHARGE TO THE LOCAL PUBLICLY OWNED TREATMENT WORKS. THE TRENCH LINE AND ASSOCIATED SUMP HAVE BEEN TAKEN OUT OF SERVICE AS OF 12 PM ON 15-MAY-2012. THE RINSE WATERS ARE BEING DIVERTED TO CONTAINERS/TOTES AND ARE BEING MANUALLY TRANSFERRED TO THE ONSITE WATER PRETREATMENT SYSTEM. LITTLEJOHN ENGINEERING ASSOCIATES, A THIRD PARTY ENVIRONMENTAL CONSULTANT, WAS ONSITE ON 15-MAY-2012 TO ASSESS THE SITUATION AND WILL DEVELOP A WORK PLAN BASED ON THOSE OBSERVATIONS FOR POTENTIAL REMEDIATION.

///WEB REPORT/// THIS WAS REPORTED VIA 3RD PARTY TO THE EPA/// MRS. COMBS STATES AROUND 9/15/06, THEY BEGAN TO DIG THEIR POOL AND REMOVED SEVERAL TONS OF WHAT WAS REFERRED TO AS "IRON-ORE" ROCK AND DEPOSITED IT IN THE YARD ON THE SIDE. PROFESSOR LYKKEN ANALYZED THE ROCKS AND FOUND THAT "IRON-ORE" ROCK CONTAINS URANIUM, THORIUM, AND IS MODERATELY RADIOACTIVE. ONE OF THE BY-PRODUCTS OF "ORE" IS RADON GAS. MRS. COMBS HAS BEEN IN AND OUT OF THE HOSPITAL. SHE IS TRYING TO HAVE MDE COME AND DISPOSE OF THE ONE TON OF BOULDERS. MRS. COMBS SENT AN E-MAIL MESSAGE DATED 2/17/07 TO EPA WITH ADDITIONAL INFORMATION.
